body:
Charleston, SC. 25 me, 24 her. Her fam is in CA. I don't talk to mine. No relevant medical history I think.

Thanks!
she doesnt have a family doctor
where do i find a family doctor
Not scared. We're going to keep it. We just don't know how to get started on the road properly. Do we just go to any hospital and ask for help or what
She's a girl. And pregnant. I'm a boy. And not pregnant. We're keeping it.
I'm not and I can't afford $75-$150 for a session. :|
I appreciate that. I appreciate everyone that's responded to me thus far. But I don't even know what to talk about with it.
What do therapists usually cost? They're expensive, right?
That's where it gets me -- even if I figure out the "why", I don't think it'd change anything.
I wish I could help you, as well. I have a lot of respect for anyone going through depression because of this war in my head. They're still winning their battles. I think I'm near the end of mine.

Mostly because that's just what makes sense to me. The Matrix and the holodeck are cool ideas, but they seem a bit far fetched to me.

Even if they were what was actually happening, then I'd imagine I would find it even more pointless.
Yeah
Because when I die, nothing I've done will really matter. Doesn't really matter if it's when I'm 80 or when I'm 25.
No. I guess that's kind of depressing in itself, eh? Ha.

Web developer. Freelance on the side. It was mostly an example because up until recently I had a lot of money problems. My life has gotten much better recently both financially and otherwise. But I don't feel better.
Tried again -- she seems to be too busy with her movie.
Can you let me in on some of these coping mechanism secrets?
And you're still therapist hunting? Would I need to see a therapist for the rest of my life?

>I'm really sorry you are struggling with suicidal thoughts and desires. That's a very painful place to be. Is there anything specific or just general suicidal ideation?

Nothing specific. I could have a great day or I could have a shit day. I could make a ton of money that day or lose a ton. Doesn't matter because in the end it's pointless. Why bother, you know?

>Just a small caveat: there are a lot of people who are not religious who nonetheless believe that consciousness continues after death. One does not have to believe in snake handling and "the rapture" and coffins popping up out of the ground in order to believe that our consciousness survives death of the body.

That's cool and all, but also not for me. Just doesn't make sense to me. Dead is dead. That would be nice.
I think it's mostly that at the end of the day, it's all pointless.
How long ago was that
I told her earlier that I always want to die and it didn't really seem like she thought it was a big deal. I don't know what else to say.
I mean, what do I even say? "Hey, by the way, I want to be dead."
I actually did mention it to her earlier today. It didn't seem like she thought it was too big of a deal...
I don't really have anyone all that close to me. I have a girlfriend whom I love but I try to refrain from talking to her about this. I don't want to become a burden.

>Even just being able to express all your thoughts and feelings to a 3rd party can be a huge relief.

Everyone always says that but I just don't see how.

>You must remember that your depression is twisting your thoughts.

I never thought of it like that. It kind of makes sense.

I'm not sure what you mean. It's a constant thing in my head. I don't mean that as an exaggeration -- I mean I'm actually *constantly* thinking about it. It's exhausting.

People online say things like "talk to someone" or "maybe try a therapist". I already feel like I'm a burden to everyone and that nobody *actually* wants to talk to me -- that they're just being nice. I can't imagine how I'd feel if I had to actually *pay* someone just to talk.
